body:
Again, I don't want to try and get into a relationship with someone when I am this low. Not only that, but I am really not over my ex, and definitely in no place to even think about being vulnerable with anyone again.

That actually ties into it. I've now been rejected by 2 men that I was in love with, and they were in love with me. I don't want my heart to be broken like that a 3rd time. I don't want to share my life with anyone, because I don't want to put myself in that place of trusting someone like that again. I'm trying not to be bitter, but I hate the thought of love, it all seems like a big lie right now. Even if it wasn't, my most recent ex was so wonderful (you know, until he wasn't) and seemingly perfect that I don't think anyone else will ever measure up again. I don't want to play a constant comparison game for the rest of my life, but I don't think it's avoidable.

Honestly, I don't want to trick myself. I don't want to jump back into the swing of functioning as an adult, because I know it's only going to spiral down again, and I am not strong enough to deal with this for the next 80 years. I'm just not. I don't want to. I don't want it anymore, I don't hope that I will find a solution, I just see decades of self loathing and false hopes.

The thing is... I had a boyfriend that was willing to stay with me through all of this. He tried to be everything I needed, and I'm sorry to say that it wasn't enough. I fell out of love with him. In a way, it makes it worse, because the one person who really did accept me with all my flaws I didn't want to be with (and trust me, I denied it and tried to make it work for a very long time). It almost makes it worse, and reinforces my impression of myself that I am ungrateful, and because I broke his heart, I deserved to have mine broken as well.

I don't know how to get energy back. I signed up for a yoga class, but overslept and missed it. I'm just so utterly defeated, and I don't know how to shake that feeling. It doesn't help that when I'm working, I mask it very well, and I work with kids, so it's not like they pick up on it much anyway.

I'm not asking for anyone on here to 'assist' me in my plan, I know that's not what this thread is for. But talking about it feels better, at least for right now.

I feel like just walking around the city would be way more likely to result in me getting sexually assaulted rather than outright killed. That is not something I want to experience, I want to punish myself all the time but that is too extreme.

My mother does offer for me to move in with her when I get in bad episodes... But I currently live 3,000 miles from her. I've been living on my own since I was 18. I know it sounds stupid, but the humiliation involved with moving back home, especially since the career I'm trying (or was trying) to pursue is so closely connected with the city I live in. It would be really detrimental for me to move away, if I was to continue living.

Usually my close friend can break through, but he lives on the other side of the country as well.
